scope: Read-only source review of the five new prepare-recording QEMU harness files. Reviewer is also an author of Native product changes, not a wholly independent system implementer. No Cargo/C/probe build, QEMU, USB operation, Git or repository edit performed.

initial_findings_resolved.finding: No actual armed event barrier before starting the only initializer/Resource run.
initial_findings_resolved.resolution: guest-init.sh waits for exactly one complete tracer armed JSON event, matching nonce/operation/ready PID/starttime, then prints ARMED before start. verify.py requires exact unique event identity/time ordering. jq -es requires length1, so empty/duplicate/partial events cannot pass.

initial_findings_resolved.finding: USBFS capability counts alone did not bind actual FD identity to original root receipt.
initial_findings_resolved.resolution: guest captures protected character-node st_dev/inode/st_rdev and sysfs dev/generation. verify.py maps two FD paths/st_dev/inodes/rdev through exact node to receipt and original bus/address/sysfs generation/configuration/full interface-driver profile. Receipt.node_device is correctly treated as st_rdev. Initializer samples preserve both original records and both mapped FDs, and bind the actual held fd to HID.

reviewed_invariants.facts: Same pool/job two received export attempts; selected Resource draft is unpublished seq+1 and exactly one prior received Resource is committed. Root records are independently checked with original correlation/UID/PID/starttime and live Native bound/no-stub state.

Guest-root plus dedicated boot markers, fixed setprivUID2000 argv, close_range before exec, per-TID syscall-entry hold. fsync candidates pin protected state.next dev/inode; initializer reads only12 fixed GET_CONFIGURATION header bytes plus4 ABI padding, not its pointer/payload. No register/result mutation. Held-before/after/resume/exit recheck actual owner/fd identity. Bounds and failure EXITKILL/reap remain.

Release observation recomputes full original baseline and exact Root terminal kind/correlation/device key/ownerUID/resource identity while held. Cleanup deadline/CLI exit does not substitute for release proof. Native arbitrary socket counts are explicitly not exact control-socket identity.

StopJob executes fixed common agent wrapper as UID1000 in background; agent SIGTERM is UID2000 and traced signal delivery must occur within hold. Original failure remains latched through explicit same-syscall release, reaping and fresh reuse. Host premature failure sends ABORT and grants bounded collection grace before terminating only its own QEMU processes.

Fresh epoch has new resource identities, actual client VHCI receipts, exact KEY1 down/up and35-byte FTDI traffic each way/host sink, original final driver/configuration/generation baseline, exact terminal cardinality, actual process UIDs/caps/ELF/init receipts and full S0 kernel guard. Guest exit0 alone cannot pass.

Clean committed source required; current Rust/support/new harness inputs locked before build, full role payload and ELF source receipts retained, head/source/binary/clean checked after actual processes exit. Host network is private socketpair and USB devices are QEMU-created, with no passthrough or host module/network mutation.

known_scope_limits: No QEMU run had occurred at this source handoff;57 static and29 constructed/jq checks are author-supplied software diagnostics, not runtime/USB evidence.
The gate is at syscall entry, not inside an active kernel USB ioctl. A blocked store or actual kernel cannot be forcibly cancelled by this harness/product.
No independent pre-listener sibling I/O exists: both devices belong to the same preparing pool; actual I/O is fresh reuse after gate release.
Native FD tables are retained but individual anonymous control UDS are not directly mapped; original Root proof and complete baseline carry release identity.
StopJob caller UID comes from fixed executed wrapper/source, not a separately sampled background command proc status. The agent/helper/tracer process identities have independent collected records.
Probe enforces x86_64 guest/root conditions and fixed node paths; this review does not establish ARM, physical hardware, universal recovery or fullPhase3.
